title: The new luxury inventory equation
summary: In this Vogue Business and GXO report, discover how leading luxury brands are rethinking inventory management to improve agility and resilience.
body_markdown:
# **The New Luxury Inventory Equation**


[Download this report](https://lets.go.gxo.com/New-luxury-inventory-equation)


## **Rethinking inventory strategies for modern brands**


**As demand becomes more volatile and customers move across channels and markets, brands need greater control over where inventory sits and how quickly it can respond.**


Produced in partnership with *Vogue Business* , this report explores how brands can build greater agility into their inventory networks, using enhanced visibility, more dynamic allocation and AI-enabled decision-making to respond to demand, protect margins and preserve the customer experience.


**In this report, you’ll discover :**


- Why brands need less stranded stock, not simply less stock
- How smarter allocation can balance accessibility and desirability
- How AI can connect demand, inventory and fulfillment decisions
- How returns, repair and refurbishment can recover more value
- What to prioritize to build more resilient inventory networks


**Only 60% of luxury inventory is sold at full price*.**


The remaining being exposed to markdowns, tied-up capital and other recovery pathways.


* Bain & Company


## **Explore untapped inventory potential**


Luxury brands have traditionally managed scarcity through tight control over production, allocation and distribution. But as demand shifts more rapidly across channels and markets, traditional inventory structures can struggle to keep pace.


### **Scarcity must be orchestrated, not assumed**


The challenge is no longer simply knowing where inventory is. It is being able to move, reallocate and deploy it quickly enough to meet demand wherever it emerges. Leading brands are building more agile inventory networks that preserve scarcity while improving responsiveness.


### **Technology should protect what makes luxury unique**


Improved visibility, forecasting and AI can help brands make more informed inventory decisions. The goal is not to replace human expertise, but to preserve the craftsmanship and customer experience that define luxury.


### ****Inventory management is becoming a strategic capability****


Inventory decisions now have direct implications for profitability, capital efficiency and customer experience. Increasingly, logistics is evolving from an operational function into a competitive advantage.


“Warehousing was once treated as a secondary part of what the business had to do. Now, it has become a core capability as brands invest in network consolidation, shared infrastructure and AI-enabled decision-making”.


Max Alexander, Senior Vice President, Global Sector Development


## ****Rethink the luxury inventory equation****


Discover how luxury brands can build more agile inventory networks, respond faster to demand and recover more value from every product.
